name: list_knowledge
description:
Browse the knowledge base directory tree.

Lists entries in a knowledge library directory. Returns directories and files
at the given path level.

Libraries:
- `knowledge` — Framework reference (LiveView, DaisyUI, Boundary, etc.)
- `project_knowledge` — Project-specific research and decisions

path.description: Subdirectory path to list (e.g. 'liveview' or 'decisions/2026'). Default: root

name: read_knowledge
description:
Read a specific knowledge entry by path.

Returns the full markdown content of a knowledge file.

Libraries:
- `knowledge` — Framework reference (LiveView, DaisyUI, Boundary, etc.)
- `project_knowledge` — Project-specific research and decisions

path.description: Path to the knowledge file (e.g. 'liveview/forms.md' or 'decisions/adr-001.md')
